Data:Mybed.json.label: My Bed
Data:Mybed.json.desc: My resting place, although I hope not my final resting place. [Use a fresh Soul card to make the bed and move your belongings out of here, if you want to choose a different bed to rest in.]

Data:N.absent.cross.json.label: What is Lost: 'The Cross'
Data:N.absent.cross.json.desc: Medusa has acknowledged her nature, and rejoined the Carapace Cross.

Data:N.absent.eternity.json.label: What is Lost: 'Eternity'
Data:N.absent.eternity.json.desc: Medusa has changed; she has set aside the stone of her long sin; she has entered History.

Data:N.absent.json.label: The Absent Friend
Data:N.absent.json.desc: Medusa haunts the days, desperate for difference. What, then, is the answer to her riddle? How will she change? Sometimes, other notables besides the Librarian make determinations of their own…

Data:N.absent.light.json.label: What is Lost: 'Light'
Data:N.absent.light.json.desc: Medusa's nature will become transparent for those with eyes to see. Perhaps, at last, she will be safe to look upon.

Data:N.absent.medusasdeath.json.label: What is Lost: 'Medusa's Death'
Data:N.absent.medusasdeath.json.desc: Medusa passes from the world. There will be only six Ligeians… for a time.

Data:N.absent.sevencoils.json.label: What is Lost: 'Seven-Coils'
Data:N.absent.sevencoils.json.desc: Medusa has abandoned her Stonely past, and become something more human - or something more mortal? That remains to be seen.

Data:N.apollo.concluded.json.label: Apollo and Marsyas: A Darkened Stage
Data:N.apollo.concluded.json.desc: We found nothing of interest in the opera's aftermath.

Data:N.apollo.duendrazon.json.label: The Ceaseless Woman
Data:N.apollo.duendrazon.json.desc: Elodie the soprano has begun a path which might end with her entry to the Mansus as a duendrazon.

Data:N.apollo.glaeterfleoge.json.label: The Glory-Winged Woman
Data:N.apollo.glaeterfleoge.json.desc: Elodie the soprano has begun a path which might end with the emergence of her winged inner self.

Data:N.apollo.json.label: Apollo and Marsyas
Data:N.apollo.json.desc: Every production of 'Apollo and Marsyas' brings something uncanny in its wake. What is it this time?

Data:N.casket.cracked.json.label: The Casket Cracked
Data:N.casket.cracked.json.desc: The seals on the Messenger's casket are cracking, and though he is not yet free, he is now sometimes seen in the world of images - unexpectedly in the background of photographs, flame-wreathed in dangerously inspired paintings.

Data:N.casket.json.label: The Messenger's Casket
Data:N.casket.json.desc: What happened with the Messenger's Casket in the hills above Cluj?

Data:N.casket.open.json.label: The Casket Opened
Data:N.casket.open.json.desc: The Messenger is free of his casket. His image is seen in photographs, in paintings, even in mirrors now - and in a depiction that was committed to my care.

Data:N.casket.sealed.json.label: The Casket Sealed
Data:N.casket.sealed.json.desc: The seals on the Messenger's casket are renewed. His image has vanished from the photographs where he was seen. Only one depiction remained, and that was committed to my care.

Data:N.claw.agdistis.quelled.json.label: Agdistis at Peace
Data:N.claw.agdistis.quelled.json.desc: The Librarian declined to pour out the 'offering' before the shrine of St Tentreto. Agdistis seems content with that; perhaps even relieved.

Data:N.claw.agdistis.upgraded.json.label: Agdistis Rising
Data:N.claw.agdistis.upgraded.json.desc: The Librarian agreed to pour out the 'offering' before the shrine of St Tentreto. Agdistis was grateful; but clearly disquieted, uncertain of what might come.

Data:N.claw.agdistis.west.json.label: The Agdistiad
Data:N.claw.agdistis.west.json.desc: Agdistis went west to see more of the shapes in the clouds. The experience has troubled and tantalised him. He has brought an 'offering' back to pour out before the shrine of St Tentreto in Brancrug...

Data:N.claw.concluded.json.label: The Clouds at Sunset
Data:N.claw.concluded.json.desc: Whatever has happened in the isles of the west is finished now.

Data:N.claw.json.label: The Claw and the Clouds
Data:N.claw.json.desc: The travelling-kinds of the Carapace Cross have alighted on the isles of the west. How have they changed those who were drawn to them?

Data:N.claw.patient.quelled.finally.json.label: A Soul at Peace
Data:N.claw.patient.quelled.finally.json.desc: The Librarian declined to pour out the 'offering' before the shrine of St Tentreto. Apparently as a result, Ehsan's patient has finally found peace.

Data:N.claw.patient.unquelled.json.label: Western Request
Data:N.claw.patient.unquelled.json.desc: Ehsan's patient went West, and returned. He has brought an 'offering' back to pour out before the shrine of St Tentreto in Brancrug…

Data:N.claw.patient.upgraded.json.label: A Troubled Soul
Data:N.claw.patient.upgraded.json.desc: The Librarian agreed to pour out the 'offering' before the shrine of St Tentreto. Ehsan's patient still dreams of the shapes in the clouds of the West…

Data:N.debt.cease.json.label: The Wangle Undone
Data:N.debt.cease.json.desc: The Suppression Bureau has closed the loophole through which mortals could win extra years of life despite the Madrugad's limits. A little more death; a lot more stability.
